requirements.title: SIGN values are PLUS, SUPPRESS, or PROCESSOR_DEFINED
requirements.definition: The scalar default character expression in a SIGN= specifier shall evaluate to PLUS, SUPPRESS, or PROCESSOR_DEFINED.

pending.sign-plus-value: Positive source/control uses SIGN="PLUS" in a context admitted by 12.6.2.1; trailing blanks/case-insensitivity remain covered by 12.6.2.1 p4.
pending.sign-suppress-value: Positive source/control uses SIGN="SUPPRESS" in a context admitted by 12.6.2.1; trailing blanks/case-insensitivity remain covered by 12.6.2.1 p4.
pending.sign-processor_defined-value: Positive source/control uses SIGN="PROCESSOR_DEFINED" in a context admitted by 12.6.2.1; trailing blanks/case-insensitivity remain covered by 12.6.2.1 p4.
pending.sign-other-value-source-control: Source-control negative changes only the SIGN= value to an unlisted token such as "MAYBE"; no numbered diagnostic is claimed for this unnumbered value rule.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish a non-default state first (for example by writing known records, initializing variables to nonzero/nonblank sentinels, or using a compile-only conforming control) and then observe only portable properties: exact internal records, successful IOSTAT zero, nonzero IOSTAT or named status values where the standard names them, required INQUIRE tokens, or required diagnosis of a numbered syntax rule or constraint. Negative/source-control plans change one property from the conforming control and do not require a particular diagnostic message, severity, exit status, or printed rule number.

requirements.title: SIGN temporarily changes the connection sign mode
requirements.definition: The SIGN= specifier temporarily changes the sign mode for the connection.

pending.sign-temporary-change: Use formatted output of a positive integer or exactly represented real on a connection opened SIGN="SUPPRESS" and statement SIGN="PLUS"; exact field includes plus, and post-statement INQUIRE(SIGN=; 12.10.2.30) sentinel reports SUPPRESS. Use SIGN="SUPPRESS" on a connection opened SIGN="PLUS" and expect no plus for positive output under 13.8.4; PROCESSOR_DEFINED is source-control only because the plus choice is processor dependent.
pending.sign-mode-restored-after-statement: The temporary-change plans explicitly pre-establish a nondefault connection mode with OPEN, perform one data transfer with a different statement specifier, and use post-transfer INQUIRE with a nonmatching sentinel to assert restoration rather than merely successful transfer.

requirements.title: Omitted SIGN leaves the connection sign mode unchanged
requirements.definition: If the SIGN= specifier is omitted, the sign mode is not changed.

pending.omitted-sign-does-not-change-mode: Open with SIGN="PLUS", omit SIGN= on transfer, prefill INQUIRE variable with a sentinel, and expect INQUIRE(SIGN=; 12.10.2.30) to remain PLUS.

accounting.rationale: Single paragraph mixes SIGN= value restriction, temporary mode effect/restoration, and omitted-specifier no-change rule.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.6.2.2-12.6.2.16, the individual io-control-spec specifiers (batch160). Every unit hash-verified by independent reviewers across two rounds. Each temporary mode specifier is split into its value restriction, its one-statement effect with restoration of the connection mode (observed by INQUIRE after the statement), and the omitted-means-unchanged rule. Round 1 found a pending plan expecting exact output from I2 on a positive value without fixing the sign mode; it now uses SS, and a sweep found no other plus-, leading-zero- or rounding-dependent exact output. R1215 and C1232 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
